user.title: Connect to Photo Wall's Central
user.description: Enter Central's address, as you open its console.

error.invalid_origin: Enter an http or https address with a host, and no path.

unreadable_player.title: A Player this Galleria cannot read
unreadable_player.description: The Player on Pi {serial} writes its line in a version this Galleria does not read. Update Galleria in HACS, or install a matching release on that Player.
